#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

int N, M, STATES;
vector<int> memo;

int go(int row, int col, int mask) {
    int idx = ((row * (N + 1) + col) * STATES + mask);
    if (memo[idx] != -1) return memo[idx];
    int res;
    if (row == M) {
        res = (mask == 0) ? 0 : INT_MIN;
    } else if (col == N) {
        res = go(row + 1, 0, mask);
    } else if (mask & 1) {
        res = go(row, col + 1, mask >> 1);
    } else {
        res = go(row, col + 1, mask >> 1);
        res = max(go(row, col + 1, (mask >> 1) + (1 << (3 * N - 1))) + 2, res);
        if (col != 0 && ((mask >> (2 * N - 1)) & 1) == 0) {
            res = max(res, go(row, col + 1, (mask >> 1) + (1 << (2 * N - 2))) + 2);
        }
        if (col != N - 1 && ((mask >> (2 * N + 1)) & 1) == 0) {
            res = max(res, go(row, col + 1, (mask >> 1) + (1 << (2 * N))) + 2);
        }
        if (col >= 2 && ((mask >> (N - 2)) & 1) == 0) {
            res = max(res, go(row, col + 1, (mask >> 1) + (1 << (N - 3))) + 2);
        }
        if (col < N - 1 && ((mask >> (N + 2)) & 1) == 0) {
            res = max(res, go(row, col + 1, (mask >> 1) + (1 << (N + 1))) + 2);
        }
    }
    memo[idx] = res;
    return res;
}

int main() {
    long long a, b;
    cin >> a >> b;
    if (a > b) {
        swap(a, b);
    }
    long long ans;
    if (a == 1) {
        long r = b % 6;
        if (r <= 3) ans = b - r;
        else if (r == 4) ans = b - 2;
        else ans = b - 1;
    } else if (a <= 5 && b <= 30) {
        N = (int)a;
        M = (int)b;
        STATES = 1 << (3 * N);
        memo.assign((M + 1) * (N + 1) * STATES, -1);
        ans = go(0, 0, 0);
    } else {
        ans = a * b - a * b % 2;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
